paragraphs: Epic Games seeks a Machine Learning Engineer, Memory who will design new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products, and help create and deliver production‑ready, high‑quality learning models and associated algorithms. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory. Being Epic means being part of a team that continually strives to do right by your community and users, and Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real‑time entertainment with a constantly growing team of engineering experts.

The requirement for Expert is satisfied by my hands‑on work building interactive systems. I have used pricing logic to create dynamic pricing engines that adapt to changing conditions, and I have built agent streaming pipelines that rely on WebSocket to maintain continuous data flow. In each case I integrated the components into larger codebases, ensuring reliable operation and extensibility. I also delivered a real‑time notification service that combined pricing calculations and WebSocket streaming to support instant user updates across multiple platforms, demonstrating the depth of my expertise.

The machine‑learning requirement is met by my extensive experience with scikit‑learn to construct and optimise models, and by applying feature engineering, cross‑validation and hyper‑parameter tuning to improve both classification and regression tasks. I have packaged these models with FastAPI and deployed them in Docker containers for production use, delivering high‑quality learning models and critically assessing their effectiveness for the ongoing roadmap. Additionally, I led a risk‑scoring project that combined scikit‑learn pipelines with feature engineering and cross‑validation to automate scoring, further demonstrating my ability to produce scalable, production‑grade machine‑learning solutions.
